Second Time At Tung's
Sep 2026 • Couples
Second time visiting Tung's Kitchen during our short stay in Vietnam, would definitely recommend! Very easy to get to - just a few minutes walk from Hanoi Square and Hố Hoàn Kiếm. The atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, we chose to sit on the balcony (we sat inside last time) and watch the world go by as we ate. The food was delicious again, the picture on the menu is definitely what comes out on your plate! I would definitely recommend people to visit when in Hanoi because the staff, especially Toni, are all incredibly friendly and helpful, always happy to help with menu recommendations or even just recommendations for Hanoi itself. Very good value for money. Very short wait times! Would definitely come back next time we're in Hanoi!
